Verified: the solution satisfies both equalities exactly and is globally feasible against the full consistent+observed stack. The reading: the parity-odd sector CAN be entirely predicted from the parity-even sector by exact matching (a genuine theoretical closure, not a data readout), but current birefringence slightly disfavors the fully-matched version -- an honest, falsifiable fork. Either the 't Hooft cubic is present (complete, testable via a chiral-cubic signal) or suppressed (better fit, matching incomplete); a sharper birefringence measurement discriminates.
